rules.name: CSRF_CONFIG
rules.why: django.middleware.csrf.get_token() masks the secret with fresh randomness per call, so the token in data-config differs between renders and between widgets.

rules.name: CSRF_INPUT
rules.why: Same as CSRF_CONFIG, for a token rendered as a form input.

rules.name: DATE
rules.why: upload_to values contain strftime codes (%Y/%m); the expanded year and month depend on the date the fixture was written.
